full_judgment:
This criminal petition for leave to appeal is directed against the order dated 16-7-2019 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 41205 of 2019. 

 3. The High Court Division came to a finding that it did not find any prima facie case in favour of accused-respondent No.1 for enlarging him on anticipatory bail and for that reason, it was not inclined to enlarge the accused-respondent on anticipatory bail. However, the High Court Division has directed accused-respondent No.1 to surrender before the Court of Metropolitan Senior Special Judge, Dhaka within 6 (six) weeks from date. There was no scope for giving direction for the purpose of surrender. We do not approve of such direction.
